title: A Quieter Hour at the Station
transcript:
Westport railway station is introducing a quieter hour every Wednesday morning. Between ten and eleven, music in the shops will be turned off and staff will avoid using cleaning machines near the waiting area. The change follows a request from a group supporting people who find busy, noisy spaces difficult to manage. Several members said they had stopped travelling by train because the station environment made them anxious.

The station manager explained that essential announcements would continue. Information about platform changes and safety must still reach passengers, even during the quieter period. Instead of repeating advertising messages through the speakers, shops will place offers on screens. Staff at the information desk will also carry small cards showing common questions and answers.

Wednesday morning was chosen because it falls between the commuter rush and the arrival of the main shopping crowd. The first suggestion had been Sunday, but engineering work often changes train services then. The manager wanted passengers to practise travelling at a time when the timetable was more predictable.

For the first month, members of the support group will visit the station and report which changes help them most. The railway company will then decide whether to extend the idea to nearby stations. It has stressed that passengers do not have to explain a medical condition to make use of the quieter hour.

questions.prompt: What prompted the station to introduce a quieter hour?
options: A request from passengers affected by noisy surroundings.
A complaint about expensive train tickets.
A plan to close the station shops.
questions.answer: A request from passengers affected by noisy surroundings.
questions.explanation: 帮助对嘈杂环境敏感人群的团体提出了请求，部分成员因此已经放弃乘火车。

questions.prompt: Which announcements will still be made?
options: Messages about platform changes and safety.
questions.answer: Messages about platform changes and safety.
questions.explanation: 站长强调站台变更和安全等必要信息仍需通过广播传达。

questions.prompt: Why was Sunday rejected for the quieter hour?
options: The waiting area is usually locked then.
Support group members work on Sundays.
Engineering work often changes the train timetable.
The information desk opens too late.
questions.answer: Engineering work often changes the train timetable.
questions.explanation: 周日常有工程施工，列车安排容易变化，不利于在较稳定的时刻表下练习出行。

questions.prompt: What will the support group do during the first month?
options: Sell tickets at the information desk.
Organise trips to other railway stations.
Report which adjustments are most helpful.
questions.answer: Report which adjustments are most helpful.
questions.explanation: 团体成员将在首月到访并反馈哪些调整最有帮助。
